title: Nothing to say? You don't *know yourself* yet

head: Running on other people's opinions
cells: Guessing what they want to hear

text: Years of saying what people want to hear. Now there's *nothing left* to say.

label: STEP 1
head: Write down 10 opinions
sub: Best movie, worst food, one hill you'd die on. Small and specific counts.

label: STEP 2
head: Try one thing you'd normally skip
sub: A class, a new genre, a solo trip. Reactions are where opinions come from.

head: She asks what you're into
r: "Old kung fu movies. The worse the dubbing, the better."
